coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit PKGBUILD due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError)
learnings: Implement automatic retries or fallback mechanisms for transient LLM API errors to prevent a single file's processing failure from causing an overall inconclusive package verdict.
